# Service configuration sections

Unified configuration for all retriever run modes.

    Service topology is selected via ``mode``; SDK pipeline defaults live
    under ``pipeline_defaults`` and apply to inprocess, batch, and service
    unless overridden at call time or via ``PipelineSpec``.

### local_models

Load Nemotron Hugging Face weights inside the service worker pod.

    When ``enabled`` is true, pipeline stages without a matching
    ``nim_endpoints.*`` URL load models from ``nemo_retriever.models.local``
    instead of calling remote NIMs. Requires the ``[local]`` (and usually
    ``[multimedia]``) install extras plus GPU resources.

    NIM URLs always take precedence when both are configured for a stage.

| Field | Type | Default | Description | Impact |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|--------|
| `local_models.enabled` | `bool` | `False` | — | — |
| `local_models.hf_cache_dir` | `str | None` | `None` | — | — |
| `local_models.device` | `str | None` | `None` | — | — |
| `local_models.warmup_on_startup` | `bool` | `False` | When true, each process-pool worker loads local HF models at startup (before the first ingest). Increases VRAM use by num_workers × model stack; pair with low worker counts. | — |
| `local_models.max_tasks_per_child` | `int | None` | `None` | Override process pool max_tasks_per_child when warmup_on_startup is true. Defaults to 10000 so warmed weights stay loaded. | — |
| `local_models.max_process_pool_workers` | `int` | `1` | When enabled, caps each ingest process pool (realtime and batch) to this many workers. Each worker loads the full local model stack into GPU memory, so keep this low (often 1). | — |
| `local_models.extract` | `LocalExtractConfig` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
| `local_models.embed` | `LocalEmbedConfig` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
| `local_models.asr` | `LocalAsrConfig` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |

### pipeline

Worker pool sizing for realtime and batch ingestion pipelines.

    Workers are abstract dispatchers — the actual work function is plugged
    in at startup.  Defaults are tuned for a CPU-only node that forwards
    work to remote NIM endpoints over HTTP.

| Field | Type | Default | Description | Impact |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|--------|
| `pipeline.realtime_workers` | `int` | `8` | Concurrent workers for low-latency page processing | — |
| `pipeline.realtime_queue_size` | `int` | `2048` | Max queued items before realtime pool rejects | — |
| `pipeline.batch_workers` | `int` | `16` | Concurrent workers for bulk document processing | — |
| `pipeline.batch_queue_size` | `int` | `4096` | Max queued items before batch pool rejects | — |

### pipeline_overrides

How permissively to accept per-request ``PipelineSpec`` overrides.

    * ``mode='reject'`` — clients may not override pipeline config at all.
      Server-side YAML is the only source of truth.
    * ``mode='allow_list'`` (default) — only the keys enumerated by the
      built-in defaults plus the ``extra_*_keys`` extensions below are
      accepted. Endpoint URLs and API keys are *always* denied.
    * ``mode='allow_all'`` — every key is accepted **except** the
      endpoint/api_key denylist. Useful in dev clusters but unsafe in
      multi-tenant deployments.

| Field | Type | Default | Description | Impact |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|--------|
| `pipeline_overrides.mode` | `Literal` | `'allow_list'` | — | — |
| `pipeline_overrides.extra_extract_keys` | `list` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
| `pipeline_overrides.extra_embed_keys` | `list` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
| `pipeline_overrides.extra_dedup_keys` | `list` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
| `pipeline_overrides.extra_split_keys` | `list` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
| `pipeline_overrides.extra_store_keys` | `list` | `PydanticUndefined` | — | — |
